answers.core: It's about an already existing core feature.
answers.workaround: The purpose is to create sensible defaults automatically, to make Subparticles more user friendly and intuitive to use. Workarounds or writing extra code does not help for this goal.

title: Automatically set the SubParticle Mode in the ParticleMaterial from "Disabled" to "At End" when a SubParticle is assigned
